category_title: Credit recovery students with self-discipline and engagement challenges
minimal_context: The student is working on an online credit recovery course during the summer session and needs to complete a modular unit assessment.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Please log into the online credit recovery course and complete the next modular unit assessment to see if you need to redo the lesson.

STUDENT: I haven't started it yet. I thought I could work on it any time I wanted since it's just a single course in the summer.

TUTOR: You still need to complete the modules. When will you do it?

STUDENT: I'll get to it eventually. I like that I can take my time and self-pace through the material so there's less stress.

TUTOR: The assignments still need to be turned in.

STUDENT: I didn't do the homework. I didn't study for test. Well the number one reason I didn't pass the course is because I was a lazy kid, and I'm still not turning in my assignments.

options.A: Agree with the student that they are having a rough time with the summer session.
options.B: Terminate the course demands and remove the modular unit assessment materials for ten seconds.
options.C: Provide regular feedback, provide for differentiation, and recommend strategies to succeed in the credit recovery course.
options.D: Review the previous lesson and play a Jeopardy game to reinforce the modular unit instruction.
